description: This Java source file defines the CorrelationHeaderFilter class, a servlet filter that manages correlation IDs for request tracing in the Fineract project.

classes.name: CorrelationHeaderFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that adds and removes correlation IDs for request tracing, extending OncePerRequestFilter.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests to handle correlation IDs if enabled.

methods.name: handleCorrelations
methods.description: Handles extraction, escaping, logging, and setting of the correlation ID from request headers.

methods.name: isAsyncDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether the filter supports asynchronous dispatch; returns false.

methods.name: shouldNotFilterErrorDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether error dispatches should be filtered; returns false.
